decision_consequences.blocked: No route, schema, service, SDL, GraphQL, readiness, provider, memory, or database code is authorized.
decision_consequences.approved_for_rest_route_first_slice: Authorizes only the Sprint 232 Slice A-D REST first slice: directory schemas, shared read service, REST route/mount, and runtime tests. SDL, GraphQL, provider, memory, write, deployment, and readiness flag changes remain blocked.
decision_consequences.deferred: No code change is permitted; the sprint engine may continue with plan-only readiness work or await a later decision checkpoint.
decision_consequences.rejected: No code change is permitted; the route attempt is removed from the active implementation queue until a new reviewed proposal supersedes this gate.
decision_consequences.expired: No further route work is permitted until the pre-code checks are refreshed and Yuri records a new explicit decision.

forbidden_changes: adding a REST practitioner directory route without approved_for_rest_route_first_slice
adding GraphQL resolvers or GraphQL mutations
adding a GraphQL runtime dependency or server

adding audit writes or audit migrations
